specialization: Sunstead pins OpenSSL's verbatim C diffusion layer implementations at commit `d94024ffc7e726566a6255228ad0a7de4cfc956d` (Apache-2.0) for AES `MixColumns` & `InvMixColumns` (`crypto/aes/aes_core.c`), SM4 `L` & `L'` (`crypto/sm4/sm4.c`), ARIA involutory diffusion `a()` (`crypto/aria/aria.c`), and Camellia `P`-function via `Camellia_Feistel` (`crypto/camellia/camellia.c`), formally proves their GF(2)-linearity, exact algebraic equivalence, invertibility/involution, and bit-parallel linear-circuit verification soundness over all 2^n inputs in pure Lean 4.36.0 (no Mathlib), and challenges contributors to minimize straight-line XOR gate count for each diffusion layer.
